title: Obaveštenje o režimu rada vozila javnog prevoza za „Dan primirja u Prvom svetskom ratu“ - 11.11.2026.godine

sections.text: Zbog neradnog praznovanja državnog praznika Dana primirja u Prvom svetskom ratu, 11.11.2026. godine (sreda), na svim linijama javnog gradskog i prigradskog prevoza putnika primenjivaće se nedeljni red vožnje .
12.11.2026.godine ( četvrtak ) na svim linijama gradskog i prigradskog prevoza primenjivaće se red vožnje za „zimski“ radni dan.
Za sve ostale informacije možete se obratiti informativnom centru JKP Direkcije za javni prevoz grada Niša na telefone 018/505-656, 018/505-665 ili putem veb sajta http://jgpnis.rs/

title: Vanredna linija 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje za Zadušnice

sections.text: Zbog održavanja verskog praznika „Zadušnice“ i povećanih zahteva za prevozom ka Novom Groblju, u petak 06.11.2026.godine, na delu trase redovne linije 8 Gabrovačka reka-Novo Groblje, uvodi se vanredna linija 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje na kojoj će u periodu od 09:00 do 15:00 časova saobraćati 2 vozila.

text_translations.en: Due to the observance of the religious holiday "Zadušnica" and increased demands for transport to Novo Groblje, on Friday 06 November 2026, on part of the route of the regular line 8 Gabrovačka reka-Novo Groblje, an extraordinary line 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje will be introduced, on which 2 vehicles will operate between 09:00 and 15:00.

sections.text: Prevoz na redovnoj liniji broj 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka obavljaće se po redu vožnje za radni dan.

text_translations.en: Transportation on the regular line number 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka will be carried out according to the working day schedule.

sections.text: Red vožnje za petak 06.11.2026. godine za vanrednu liniju 8L možete pogledati ovde .

text_translations.en: Timetable for Friday 06.11.2026. year for the extraordinary line 8L can be viewed here.

sections.text: U subotu 07.11.2026. godine uvodi se vanredna linija 8L Trg Kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje na kojoj će u periodu od 07:00 do 15:00 časova saobraćati 4 vozila.

text_translations.en: On Saturday 07.11.2026., the extraordinary line 8L Trg Kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje is introduced, on which 4 vehicles will operate between 07:00 and 15:00.

sections.text: Prevoz na redovnoj liniji broj 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka obavljaće se po subotnjem redu vožnje.

text_translations.en: Transportation on regular line number 8 Novo Groblje - Gabrovačka reka will be carried out according to the Saturday timetable.

sections.text: Red vožnje za subotu 07.11.2026. godine za vanrednu liniju 8L možete pogledati ovde .

text_translations.en: Schedule for Saturday 07.11.2026. year for the extraordinary line 8L can be viewed here.

sections.text: Ovim putem želimo da uputimo apel svim sugrađanima da za potrebe prevoza do Novog Groblja koriste vozila javnog prevoza kako bi se izbeglo stvaranje gužvi u saobraćaju.

text_translations.en: Hereby, we would like to appeal to all fellow citizens to use public transport vehicles for transportation to Novi Groblje in order to avoid traffic jams.

title_translations.en: Emergency line 8L Trg kralja Aleksandra - Novo Groblje for Remembrance

title: Izmena reda vožnje na liniji br.4 Bubanj-Čalije od 01.11.2026.

sections.text: Od nedelje, 01.11.2026. godine vrši se izmena reda vožnje na liniji broj 4 Bubanj - Čalije za radni dan, subotu i nedelju.

text_translations.en: From Sunday, 01.11.2026., the schedule of the route number 4 Bubanj - Čalija is changed for working days, Saturdays and Sundays.

sections.text: Izmena reda vožnje vrši se u cilju unapređenja tačnosti i pouzdanosti realizacije polazaka, kao i optimalne organizacije rada vozila, uz zadržavanje visokog nivoa bezbednosti putnika i ostalih učesnika u saobraćaju.

text_translations.en: The timetable change is made in order to improve the accuracy and reliability of the implementation of departures, as well as the optimal organization of vehicle operation, while maintaining a high level of safety for passengers and other traffic participants.

sections.text: Red vožnje možete pogledati ovde .

text_translations.en: You can see the timetable here.

title: Izmena trase u ulici Dimitrija Tucovića za linije 1, 10, 26, 33, 36, 36a

sections.text: Obaveštavamo vas da će u sredu 28.10.2026.godine u vremenskom periodu od 10.00 do 16.00 časova doći do zatvaranja saobraćaja u ulici Dimitrija Tucovića zbog asfaltiranja kružne raskrsnice sa ulicom Bubanjski heroji (kod benzinske stanice NIS) u naselju Ledena stena u delu od kružne raskrsnice sa ulicom Bubanjski heroji do kružne raskrsnice sa ulicom Petra Aranđelovića.

text_translations.en: We inform you that on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., there will be a traffic closure on Dimitrija Tucovića Street due to asphalting of the roundabout with Bubanjski Heroji Street (near the NIS gas station) in Ledena Stena, in the area from the roundabout with Bubanjski Heroji Street to the roundabout with Petar Aranđelović Street.

sections.text: Javni prevoz će se odvijati ulicama Bubanjski heroji i Petra Aranđelovića. Stajalište koja se neće koristiti je “Ledena stena (brdo)“. Polasci na liniji Niška Banja-Ledena stena realizovaće se do kružne raskrsnice ulica Bubanjskih heroja i Petra Aranđelovića. Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se postojeća stajališta na zahtev putnika.

text_translations.en: Public transport will take place on Bubanjski heroji and Petar Aranđelović streets. The stop that will not be used is "Ice rock (hill)". Departures on the Niška Banja-Ledena Stena line will be realized up to the roundabout of Bubanjski heroja and Petar Aranđelović streets. On the changed part of the route, existing stops will be used at the request of passengers.

sections.text: Za sve ostale informacije možete se obratiti informativnom centru JKP Direkcije za javni prevoz grada Niša na telefone 018/505-656, 018/505-665 ili putem veb sajta http://jgpnis.rs/

text_translations.en: For all other information, you can contact the information center of the PUC Directorate for Public Transport of the City of Niš at 018/505-656, 018/505-665 or via the website http://jgpnis.rs/

title: Izmena trase linija javnog prevoza od 20.10.2026.godine do 22.10.2026.godine

sections.text: Zbog održavanja političkog predizbornog skupa na Trgu kralja Milana i u ulicama Generala Milojka Lešjanina i Vožda Karađorđa, vrši se potpuna obustava saobraćaja u ulicama Generala Milojka Lešjanina i Vožda Karađorđa, na potezu od „Ureda“ do „Suda“ u periodu od 8:00 dana 20.10.2026. godine do 20:00 dana 22.10.2026. godine .

text_translations.en: Due to the holding of a political pre-election rally on Trg Kralja Milana and in the streets of General Milojko Lešjanin and Vožde Karađorđe, there is a complete suspension of traffic in the streets of General Milojko Lešjanin and Vožde Karađorđe, on the stretch from "Office" to "Court" in the period from 8:00 on 20.10.2026. until 20:00 on 22.10.2026. years.

sections.text: Trase linija javnog prevoza u navedenom periodu biće preusmerene na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: Routes of public transport lines in the specified period will be rerouted as follows:

sections.text: - u smeru od „Ureda“ ka „Sudu“, za linije broj 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 13, 14 preko Trga kralja Aleksandra, Trga Pavla Stojkovića, Cara Dušana, Sinđelićev trg do raskrnice „Sud“, i dalje redovnom trasom;

text_translations.en: - in the direction from "Office" to "Sud", for lines number 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 13, 14 via Trg kralja Aleksandar, Trg Pavle Stojković, Tsar Dušan, Sinđelićev trg to the intersection "Sud", and further along the regular route;

sections.text: - u smeru od „Suda“ ka „Uredu“, za linije broj 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 13 od raskrsnice „Sud“ ulicama Sinđelićev trg, Nikole Pašića do Trga kralja Aleksandra i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: - in the direction from "Court" to "Office", for lines number 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, 11, 13 from the intersection "Sud" along the streets Sinđelićev trg, Nikola Pašić to Trg kralja Aleksandar and further along the regular route.

sections.text: - Prigradske linije broj 18, 19, 20, 20L, 21, 22, 23, 23L, 23K i 37 u smeru ka prigradskoj autobuskoj stanici , od raskrsnice „Sud“ preusmeravaju se ulicama Kralja Stefana Prvovenčanog, Most Mladosti, Bulevar Nikole Tesle, Aleksandra Medvedeva, Bulevar 12. februar.

text_translations.en: - Suburban lines number 18, 19, 20, 20L, 21, 22, 23, 23L, 23K and 37 in the direction of the suburban bus station, from the "Sud" intersection, they are diverted through the streets of Kralja Stefan Prvovenčani, Most Mladost, Boulevard Nikola Tesla, Aleksandar Medvedeva, Boulevard 12 February.

sections.text: - Prigradske linije broj 18, 19, 20, 20L, 21, 22, 23, 23L, 23K i 37 u odlasku sa autobuske stanice preusmeravaju se ulicama Bulevar 12. februar, Aleksandra Medvedeva, Bulevar Nikole Tesle, Most mladosti, Kralja Stefana Prvovenčanog do raskrsnice „Sud“ i nadalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: - Suburban lines number 18, 19, 20, 20L, 21, 22, 23, 23L, 23K and 37, leaving the bus station, are diverted along the streets 12 February Boulevard, Aleksandar Medvedeva, Nikola Tesla Boulevard, Bridge of Youth, Kralja Stefan Prvovenčanigo to the intersection "Court" and further along the regular route.

sections.text: Dana 21.10.2026. godine u periodu od 12:00 do 24:00 vrši se potpuna obustava saobraćaja u ulici Heroja sa Paštrika na delu od Univerzitetskog trga do kružne raskrsnice sa Bulevarom Nikole Tesle.

text_translations.en: On 21.10.2026. in the period from 12:00 to 24:00, there is a complete suspension of traffic in Heroja sa Paštrika Street, in the part from University Square to the roundabout with Nikola Tesla Boulevard.

sections.text: Prigradske linije broj 14, 14A, 15, 16, 17, 17L u navedenom periodu u smeru ka prigradskoj autobuskoj stanici biće preusmerene ulicama Bulevar Nikole Tesle, Aleksandra Medvedeva, Bulevar 12. februar.

text_translations.en: Suburban lines No. 14, 14A, 15, 16, 17, 17L in the specified period in the direction of the suburban bus station will be rerouted through the streets of Boulevard Nikola Tesla, Aleksandar Medvedeva, Boulevard 12 February.

sections.text: Privremena autobuska stajališta biće uspostavljena u ulici Cara Dušana kod zgrade Fonda PIO i u ulici Nikole Pašića kod glavnog ulaza u zgradu Skupštine grada.

text_translations.en: Temporary bus stops will be established in Cara Dušana Street near the PIO Fund building and in Nikola Pašića Street near the main entrance to the City Assembly building.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase linija koristiti postojeća stajališta na zahtev putnika.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route of the line, use existing stops at the request of passengers.
